rockArt.reason: Mossdeep's white rock, its tops and faces, and the shore rock on the water's edge (not its trees or the brown rocks in the sea): blocked, it stands as rock bands (Mossdeep City, Routes 124-129; Route 126's crater round Sootopolis lay flat). The crater's dark mouth (pits) lies on the rock's foot, the rim rising to it; this rock stands up to four tiles over the sea (capTiles). Local metatile ids.
